dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible network of 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the upper dorsal surface, characterized by thin, high-contrast light perimeters approximately 2-5 pixels wide that enclose darker interior regions with a sharp gradient transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A single, prominent, high-intensity cluster of white/light-gray pixels is located at the anterior-ventral margin. This cluster lacks an internal gradient and shows high core pixel concentration. Sparse, smaller light-pixel clusters are distributed throughout the dorsal reticulated pattern.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationship defined by an obtuse triangle formed by connecting the centroid of the large anterior-ventral blob to the centroids of two prominent circular macro-annuli located in the superior dorsal-posterior quadrant.

other_distinctive_markers: Widespread reticulated pattern across the dorsal surface consisting of interconnected, high-contrast light filaments forming a continuous honeycomb-like structure.
